raw_html: [[Absorb Beholder and Doomsphere Spells]] - 25 Charges[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Absorb Beholder and Doomsphere Spells]]:''' This effect absorbs the standard spells spells from [[beholder]] and [[doomsphere]] eye beams. A charge is expended for each eye beam absorbed.
